summary: Full end-to-end test of Somnio Atelier (FastAPI + Expo). Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed (seed idempotency, 4-role login + case-insensitive, role-filtered /api/orders, 26-step phase grouping, client step masking, manufacturer step complete with China time, associate forward, auto-forward toggle + cascade, admin customs upload+get, 403 role enforcement, admin create-user/create-order). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login screen with 4 demo pills, admin home with New Commission + Manage Users + 3 stats, order detail with 5 phase accordions and step rows visible, admin-only Customs screen, Users screen with 4 horizontal filter chips (no wrap), client/manufacturer role-restricted home screens all verified. Customs button and create/manage actions correctly hidden from non-admin roles. Manufacturer sees only assigned orders, client sees only own orders. No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). One minor console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (React Native Web).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Source likely a third-party RN component or older Pressable usage. Non-blocking but should migrate to style.pointerEvents to avoid future breakage.

action_items: Address `props.pointerEvents is deprecated` console warning: migrate any `pointerEvents='none'` props to `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` (search project for `pointerEvents=`).
Optional: upgrade to expected Expo versions (expo@54.0.35, expo-font@14.0.12, expo-router@6.0.24) — currently slightly behind but functional.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~600 lines; acceptable but starting to grow — consider splitting routes (auth/users/orders/customs) into separate routers if features expand.

GET /api/users restricted to admin/associate is correct, but associate can list ALL users (including other associates' clients). If multi-tenant isolation is required for associates, filter list by associate_id at the query level.
DELETE /api/orders endpoint missing — TEST_ orders created during tests cannot be cleaned up via API (acceptable for demo; consider adding admin DELETE).
complete_step does not enforce sequence (any step can be completed independently). If the 26 steps must be sequential, add a check that step_number == current_step.
JWT_SECRET has a default value in code — fine for demo, but production should fail-fast if env var is missing.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ orders were created via POST /api/orders during backend testing (TEST_new piece, TEST_other) and remain in DB. Demo seed users + SMN-DEMO0001 are intact and idempotent. Steps 4 and 5 of SMN-DEMO0001 are now also completed/forwarded as side-effects of testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo order SMN-DEMO0001 now has steps 1-5 completed/forwarded (not just first 3) due to step-completion tests. Two extra orders (TEST_new piece, TEST_other) belong to the demo client. Re-running seed is safe (idempotent). All testIDs are well-mapped and stable. When testing the create-user modal via UI, scroll the horizontal filter chip row before clicking off-screen chips — Playwright may timeout on `filter-chip-clients` if not scrolled into view (workshops/associates are visible by default).
